StatusAxes.description: Independent evidence, constraint and authorization axes; not a lifecycle. Authorization validity is facet- and branch-scoped.

child_ids.description: Ordered direct components including cue leaves, in source reading order. The array index is the only stored order; graph component_index is a derived, parent-edge-local value.

claim_authority.description: Maximum allowed effect on canonical semantics; S is suggestion-only and does not authorize anything.
